fields.name: service_type
fields.label: Track Service
fields.help:
Manually set quantities on order: Invoice based on the manually entered quantity, without creating an analytic account.
Timesheets on contract: Invoice based on the tracked hours on the related timesheet.
Create a task and track hours: Create a task on the sales order validation and track the work h

fields.name: tracking
fields.label: Tracking
fields.help: Ensure the traceability of a storable product in your warehouse.

fields.name: show_on_hand_qty_status_button
fields.label: Show On Hand Qty Status Button

fields.name: nbr_moves_in
fields.label: Nbr Moves In
fields.help: Number of incoming stock moves in the past 12 months

fields.name: nbr_moves_out
fields.label: Nbr Moves Out
fields.help: Number of outgoing stock moves in the past 12 months

fields.name: active
fields.label: Active
fields.help: If unchecked, it will allow you to hide the product without removing it.

fields.name: type
fields.label: Product Type
fields.help:
Goods are tangible materials and merchandise you provide.
A service is a non-material product you provide.

fields.name: invoice_policy
fields.label: Invoicing Policy
fields.help:
Ordered Quantity: Invoice quantities ordered by the customer.
Delivered Quantity: Invoice quantities delivered to the customer.

fields.name: is_storable
fields.label: Track Inventory
fields.help: A storable product is a product for which you manage stock.

fields.name: lot_valuated
fields.label: Valuation by Lot/Serial number
fields.help: If checked, the valuation will be specific by Lot/Serial number.

fields.name: list_price
fields.label: Sales Price
fields.help: Price at which the product is sold to customers.

fields.name: uom_id
fields.label: Unit of Measure
fields.help: Default unit of measure used for all stock operations.

fields.name: taxes_id
fields.label: Sales Taxes
fields.help: Default taxes used when selling the product

fields.name: standard_price
fields.label: Cost
fields.help:
Value of the product (automatically computed in AVCO).
        Used to value the product when the purchase cost is not known (e.g. inventory adjustment).
        Used to compute margins on sale orders.

fields.name: supplier_taxes_id
fields.label: Purchase Taxes
fields.help: Default taxes used when buying the product

fields.name: optional_product_ids
fields.label: Optional Products
fields.help: Optional Products are suggested whenever the customer hits *Add to Cart* (cross-sell strategy, e.g. for computers: warranty, software, etc.).

fields.name: description_sale
fields.label: Sales Description
fields.help: A description of the Product that you want to communicate to your customers. This description will be copied to every Sales Order, Delivery Order and Customer Invoice/Credit Note

fields.name: expense_policy
fields.label: Re-Invoice Costs
fields.help: Validated expenses, vendor bills, or stock pickings (set up to track costs) can be invoiced to the customer at either cost or sales price.

fields.name: sequence
fields.label: Sequence
fields.help: Gives the sequence order when displaying a product list

fields.name: service_to_purchase
fields.label: Subcontract Service
fields.help: If ticked, each time you sell this product through a SO, a RfQ is automatically created to buy the product. Tip: don't forget to set a vendor on the product.

fields.name: uom_po_id
fields.label: Purchase Unit
fields.help: Default unit of measure used for purchase orders. It must be in the same category as the default unit of measure.

fields.name: landed_cost_ok
fields.label: Is a Landed Cost
fields.help: Indicates whether the product is a landed cost: when receiving a vendor bill, you can allocate this cost on preceding receipts.

fields.name: split_method_landed_cost
fields.label: Default Split Method
fields.help: Default Split Method when used for Landed Cost

fields.name: purchase_method
fields.label: Control Policy
fields.help:
On ordered quantities: Control bills based on ordered quantities.
On received quantities: Control bills based on received quantities.

fields.name: has_available_route_ids
fields.label: Routes can be selected on this product

fields.name: route_ids
fields.label: Routes
fields.help: Depending on the modules installed, this will allow you to define the route of the product: whether it will be bought, manufactured, replenished on order, etc.

fields.name: responsible_id
fields.label: Responsible
fields.help: This user will be responsible of the next activities related to logistic operations for this product.

fields.name: sale_delay
fields.label: Customer Lead Time
fields.help: Delivery lead time, in days. It's the number of days, promised to the customer, between the confirmation of the sales order and the delivery.

fields.name: use_expiration_date
fields.label: Expiration Date
fields.help: When this box is ticked, you have the possibility to specify dates to manage product expiration, on the product and on the corresponding lot/serial numbers

fields.name: expiration_time
fields.label: Expiration Date
fields.help: Number of days after the receipt of the products (from the vendor or in stock after production) after which the goods may become dangerous and must not be consumed. It will be computed on the lot/serial number.

fields.name: use_time
fields.label: Best Before Date
fields.help: Number of days before the Expiration Date after which the goods starts deteriorating, without being dangerous yet. It will be computed on the lot/serial number.

fields.name: removal_time
fields.label: Removal Date
fields.help: Number of days before the Expiration Date after which the goods should be removed from the stock. It will be computed on the lot/serial number.

fields.name: alert_time
fields.label: Alert Date
fields.help: Number of days before the Expiration Date after which an alert should be raised on the lot/serial number. It will be computed on the lot/serial number.

fields.name: property_account_income_id
fields.label: Income Account
fields.help: Keep this field empty to use the default value from the product category.

fields.name: property_account_expense_id
fields.label: Expense Account
fields.help: Keep this field empty to use the default value from the product category. If anglo-saxon accounting with automated valuation method is configured, the expense account on the product category will be used.

fields.name: property_account_creditor_price_difference
fields.label: Price Difference Account
fields.help: This account is used in automated inventory valuation to record the price difference between a purchase order and its related vendor bill when validating this vendor bill.

fields.name: uom_category_id
fields.label: UoM Category
fields.help: Conversion between Units of Measure can only occur if they belong to the same category. The conversion will be made based on the ratios.
